title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Plump shrimp seared in a hot skillet and tossed in garlicky lemon butter with parsley. Fifteen minutes, one pan.

image.alt: A skillet of shrimp in garlic butter with parsley and lemon

ingredients.prep: peeled and deveined, tails on or off

steps.text: Pat the shrimp very dry and season with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook without moving until pink underneath, {time 1-2 min}. Flip and cook {time 1 min} more. Move to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium and add the butter, garlic and pepper flakes. Stir until the garlic is fragrant but not browned, {time 1 min}.
Return the shrimp, add the lemon juice and toss until the shrimp are opaque and glossy with sauce, {time 1 min}. Scatter with parsley and serve with rice, pasta or crusty bread.

notes: Frozen shrimp are fine; thaw them overnight in the fridge or in a bowl of cold water for 15 minutes.
